# XHelpers Pro 1.0.2
**Added** - **Screen Shelf** — Keep screenshots and images in a floating shelf, add images from Finder, the clipboard, file promises, or Screen Pin, then drag them into other apps, preview them, copy them, or save permanent copies. Shelf items expire automatically after 24 hours. - **Expanded Screen Tools** — Capture and act on recognized text, scan QR codes and barcodes, translate or read selected text aloud, pin a region, measure a region, and pick a screen color from one Screen Tools menu.
**Improved** - **Screen Shelf Interaction** — An image can begin dragging on the first click even when the shelf belongs to an inactive app, and compact, minimal, and collapsed layouts make the shelf easier to keep nearby. - **Screen Tool Presentation** — Tool windows reliably move to the foreground after they are opened from the menu bar. - **Screen Pin Controls** — Hover controls adapt to narrow pins without clipping the image or overflowing the panel.
**Fixed** - **Screen Pin Stability** — Prevents a SwiftUI/AppKit constraint-update loop that could make XHelpers Pro quit after pinning a screen region.
